svg.title: Target groups and the ALB - general concept
svg.text: Target groups and the ALB — the general idea
An ALB decides which requests go where. A target group says who can serve them and checks that they are alive.
A rule can also redirect, return a fixed
always forwards to a target group.
path, host, header, method, source IP
Who serves them — and are they alive?
targets + port + health check + routing settings
Why do we need a target group at all?
A stable name for a moving pool
Tasks and instances come and go and
change IPs. Rules point at the group,
so the ALB config never lists IPs.
The ALB probes every target on the
health-check path and only routes to
belong to the group, not the ALB.
ECS services and Auto Scaling groups
